operation.description: Users with admin access to the repository can create an autolink.

is_alphanumeric.description: Whether this autolink reference matches alphanumeric characters. If true, the `<num>` parameter of the `url_template` matches alphanumeric characters `A-Z` (case insensitive), `0-9`, and `-`. If false, this autolink reference only matches numeric characters.

key_prefix.description: This prefix appended by certain characters will generate a link any time it is found in an issue, pull request, or commit.

url_template.description: The URL must contain `<num>` for the reference number. `<num>` matches different characters depending on the value of `is_alphanumeric`.

operation.summary: Create an autolink reference for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/responses/validation_failed.description: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.

is_alphanumeric.description: Whether this autolink reference matches alphanumeric characters. If false, this autolink reference only matches numeric characters.

key_prefix.description: The prefix of a key that is linkified.

url_template.description: A template for the target URL that is generated if a key was found.
